nodes.label: Part B - parallel semantic-extraction subagents
nodes.rationale: MANDATORY use of the Agent tool with subagent_type=general-purpose (never Explore, which is read-only and cannot Write chunk files to disk) dispatched all in one message so subagents genuinely run in parallel rather than sequentially; each subagent processes a 20-25 file chunk and writes its own chunk JSON to an absolute CHUNK_PATH.

nodes.label: graphify node ID normalization rule
nodes.rationale: IDs must be `{immediate_parent_dir}_{filename_stem}_{entity}`, lowercase, deterministic from label alone, with no chunk-number suffixes, so the same entity always yields the same ID regardless of which chunk processes it and so semantic-extraction IDs align with AST-extraction IDs (mismatched formats create orphan ghost-duplicate nodes).

nodes.label: graphify confidence_score rubric (EXTRACTED/INFERRED/AMBIGUOUS)
nodes.rationale: Discrete rubric (0.95/0.85/0.75/0.65/0.55, never 0.5) was chosen because production data showed models collapse a continuous 0-1 range into a bimodal distribution (>50% at 0.5, >40% at 0.85+) when given a free range instead of fixed anchor points.
